Right place (Waitangi coords) and colour, but it is a waka-house shelter among trees on a lawn: flat, not spectacular, does not convey the Treaty.
Pleasant wide view of the grounds and bay, but the Treaty House/waka house are tiny or indistinct; a visitor would not recognise a named thing. 1.9:1 crop also risky.
Treaty House itself, the signing place and the very attraction behind "where NZ began"; sharp colour 2009 photo, 3168x2112, central subject. Plain but the building is the subject.
Right place and recognisable waka house, but colours look strongly boosted/processed; and it shows the canoe house rather than the Treaty. Acceptable runner-up, not chosen.
Attractive golden-light waka on Waitangi shore (5184x3456), but a waka rather than the Treaty story; "where NZ began" is not shown. Good alternative for a canoe reason.
